verdict.rationale: IRCC's own pages point to online channels for the core transaction. It links to 'Apply for a work permit', offers GCKey and employer accounts, and lets users check application status and processing times online. That implies applications are handled online, but none of the cited pages explicitly says submission and payment can be completed end-to-end online. The founder-specific Start-up Visa page also states the program is closed except to holders of a 2025 commitment certificate. missing for 10: explicit first-party statement that applications (including Start-up Visa) can be submitted and paid fully online, documentation of the online application portal flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
